name: Vertical Parallax Slideshow
description: Full-screen image slideshow where slides push each other vertically with an inner parallax shift, driven by wheel, touch drag or arrow buttons.
contents: Scroll hint text with previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer drag move to the next or previous slide through a GSAP Observer
Current slide slides out while the next slides in, with the inner image shifting for parallax
Input is ignored while a transition is running
editableByProps: Images, number of slides, background and text colors
Transition duration, easing, parallax amount and wheel sensitivity
Nav button visibility, size, colors and hint text

needsCodeEdit.change: Change arrow symbols on the buttons
needsCodeEdit.where: The ← and → buttons in the showNavButtons block
yPercent tweens inside the navigate function

fixed: Observer captures wheel and touch input over the slideshow only
Slides are shown only after all images have loaded
